milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the green concrete structure and face it, modeling 'the player can see the target.' The target is the center of the green concrete structure at spawn-relative (7, 1, 3). max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the blocks.
